subject: Insurance
title: The Birth of Cat Modeling
description: One-minute skill: The Birth of Cat Modeling.

hook.text: After Hurricane Andrew bankrupted 11 insurers in 1992.

buildup.text: Before Andrew, insurers used historical averages. A bad year was just bad luck.

discovery.text: Clark's model simulated hurricane paths and building vulnerabilities.

twist.text: Her company, AIR Worldwide, was initially ignored. Insurers didn't trust computers over experience.

climax.text: Karen Clark's model became the standard. Today, no property insurer operates without catastrophe modeling.

quiz.question: What triggered the creation of catastrophe modeling?
